name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 9 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 23 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 20 hours starting 2025-07-19, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 1.76 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
